description: This Java class, LogWrapper, implements a logging utility that wraps Android's native Log class. It acts as a node in a chain for logging messages, allowing logs to be forwarded to subsequent nodes. It provides methods to get and set the next LogNode in the chain and overrides the println method to handle message formatting and forwarding.

classes.name: LogWrapper
classes.description: A logging utility class that wraps Android's native Log and forwards log messages to the next node in a chain.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode to forward logs to.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Logs a message with a specified priority, tag, and optional Throwable; forwards the log to the next node.
